_note: Placeholder ease/stretch rules for the fit-score. Calibrate on real garment returns/fit-feedback post-launch. 'ease' = garment girth minus body girth (cm). Guardrail (spec §5): the fit-score tells the truth — a borderline-tight region is reported snug, never rounded up to 'fits'.
_pref_note: Fit is measurement x PREFERENCE. These offsets (cm) shift the target ease per the user's desired fit, applied per-garment so combinations (baggy top + baggy bottom, fitted top + relaxed bottom) fall out. Declared now (cold-start); learned from what they actually keep/wear later (V2). Placeholders — calibrate on real preference data.
